buyer_added_terms.text: 1. Generic Bidders are advised to check applicable GST on their own before quoting. Buyer will not take any responsibility in this regards. GST reimbursement will be as per actuals or as per applicable rates (whichever is lower), subject to the maximum of quoted GST %. 2. Generic Scope of supply includes Training: Number of employees to be trained

2 , Place for Training at kalpakkam and Duration of training 1 days. 3. Inspection Pre-dispatch inspection at Seller premises (Fee/Charges to be borne by the BUYER): Before dispatch, the goods will be inspected by Buyer / Consignee or their Authorized Representative or by Nominated External Inspection Agency (independently or jointly with Buyer or Consignee as decided by the Buyer) at Seller premises (or at designated place for inspection as declared / communicated by the seller) for their compliance to the contract specifications. Fee/Charges taken by the External inspection Agency and any external laboratories testing charges shall be borne by the Buyer. For in-house testing, the Sellers will provide necessary facilities free of cost. Seller shall notify the Buyer through e-mail about readiness of goods for pre-dispatch inspection and Buyer will notify the Seller about the Authorized Representative/ Nominated External Inspection Agency and the date for testing. The goods would be dispatched to consignee only after clearance in pre-dispatch inspection. Consignee's right of rejection as per GTC in respect of the goods finally received at his location shall in no way be limited or waived by reason of the goods having previously been inspected, tested and passed by Buyer/ Consignee or its Nominated External Inspection Agency prior to the goods' shipment. While bidding, the sellers should take into account 7 days for inspection from the date of email offering the goods for inspection. Any delay in inspection beyond 7 days shall be on the part of the buyer and shall be regularised without Liquidated Damages. When there is requirement of submission the advance sample, the seller shall inform the buyer promptly through emails about the date of submission of sample to the buyer nominated Inspection agency. 4. Scope of Supply Scope of supply (Bid price to include all cost components) : Supply Installation Testing Commissioning of Goods and Training of operators and providing Statutory Clearances required (if any) 5. Certificates Bidder's offer is liable to be rejected if they don't upload any of the certificates / documents sought in the Bid document, ATC and Corrigendum if any. 6. Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC Buyer Added text based ATC clauses Our File Ref No: DPS/MRPU/1/2/23846 1. Scope of supply (Bid price to include all cost components): Pre-Despatch Inspection, Supply, Installation , Commissioning, Training and Warranty of Online UPS with 30 minute battery backup and 50m 75 s q.mm 5-Core Armoured copper output cable with glands and lugs as technical specification annex ure attached. 2. Warranty & Certification: 2.1 Note to Seller: Installation and Commissioning shall involve all the interconnections, any cabling betwe en the power source, switch boards within a 50-metre range for input power and connecting the output po wer within the Scope of the seller. 2.2 The battery bank shall consist of a minimum of 40 Nos. of 12 V, 150 Ah SMF-VRLA batteries housed in f our heavy-duty powder-coated MS battery racks. With interlinked battery cables, a battery PCB and an on- off switch. Each rack shall accommodate 10 batteries arranged per tier. The maximum dimensions of eac h rack shall not exceed 600 mm (W) × 1750 mm (L) × 2000 mm (H), including all structural members and cable management provisions. The design shall ensure adequate ventilation, maintenance accessibility, el ectrical safety, and mechanical stability. 3. Bid Acceptance Criteria (BAC) 3.1 The bidder shall be the OEM.

3.2 The offered UPS shall comply with all technical specifications and additional specification parameters s pecified in the bid. Documentary evidence in the form of OEM datasheets/catalogues shall be submitted. 3.3 The bidder shall submit a detailed technical compliance statement against each specification, indicatin g compliance (Yes/No) along with supporting document reference. 3.4 The bidder shall submit NABL/ILAC/Central Government Laboratory test reports for the offered UPS mo del, if available. 3.5 The OEM bidder shall have supplied at least one similar UPS system of rating 120 kVA or above to Gov ernment Departments, PSU, Research Institutions, Universities, Space, Nuclear, Defence or Industrial esta blishments. Documentary proof shall be submitted. 3.6 The bidder shall guarantee 30 minutes of backup at full rated load and provide battery sizing calculatio ns along with the offer. 3.7 The supplier shall provide installation, testing and commissioning, including all cabling, terminations, g lands, lugs and accessories within the specified scope. 3.8 The battery rack dimensions shall comply with the specified maximum dimensions and layout require ments. 3.9 Offers without complete technical documentation, compliance statement, OEM, or supporting catalogu es shall be liable for rejection during technical evaluation. 4. Technical Evaluation Criteria A bid shall be considered technically responsive only if the following requirements are fulfilled: 4.1 Compliance with Technical Specifications All mandatory technical specifications and additional specification parameters specified in the bid shall be complied with. 4.2 Technical Compliance Statement The bidder shall submit a duly filled and signed Technical Compliance Statement against each requirement , clearly indicating the offered specification and corresponding catalogue/datasheet page reference. 4.3 OEM Datasheet / Catalogue The offered UPS model shall be supported by the manufacturer's official technical datasheet/catalogue. Th e specifications offered in the bid shall be traceable to the submitted OEM documents. 4.4 OEM : The bidder Shall be original Equipment manufacturer. 4.5 Previous Supply Experience The bidder/OEM shall submit details of earlier supplies of similar Online UPS systems of 120 kVA or above, along with relevant purchase orders and satisfactory performance/completion certificates. 4.6 Required Certificates and Test Reports Required certificates, test reports and supporting technical documents specified in the bid shall be submitt ed. 4.7 Installation & Commissioning The bidder shall undertake the complete scope of installation, testing and commissioning, including all req uired interconnections, cable laying, termination and associated accessories within the specified scope of s upply. Installation, testing and commissioning shall be completed within 10 days from the date of delivery of the complete material at the consignee site, excluding the delivery period of 60 days. 4.8 Battery Backup Guarantee The bidder/OEM shall guarantee a minimum 30-minute battery backup at the specified UPS load and shall submit suitable battery sizing calculations/supporting documents. 4.9 Battery Rack Compliance

The bidder shall confirm compliance with the specified battery rack configuration and maximum dimension s as drawing. 4.10 Technical Responsiveness Only bids satisfying all mandatory requirements and supported by adequate documentary evidence shall be considered technically responsive for further evaluation. 5. Final Acceptance The material shall be finally accepted only after satisfactory completion of physical inspection, documentat ion verification, installation, commissioning, functional testing and verification of the specified battery bac kup performance, and after submission of all required test reports, certificates, manuals and warranty doc uments. 6. Bank Guarantee shall be from SBI or any nationalized bank except Gramin/Cooperative Bank. 7. Post supply inspection is not allowed. Any offer containing the conditions of post supply inspection will b e summarily rejected. 8. All the other terms & conditions as per the 'buyer added bid specific ATC document' attached shall be a dhered to. . 7. Warranty Warranty period of the supplied products shall be 2 years from the date of final acceptance of goods or after completion of installation, commissioning & testing of goods (if included in the scope of supply), at consignee location. OEM Warranty certificates must be submitted by Successful Bidder at the time of delivery of Goods. The seller should guarantee the rectification of goods in case of any break down during the guarantee period. Seller should have well established Installation, Commissioning, Training, Troubleshooting and Maintenance Service group in INDIA for attending the after sales service. Details of Service Centres near consignee destinations are to be uploaded along with the bid. 8. Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC Buyer uploaded ATC document Click here to view the file. 9. Forms of EMD and PBG Bidders can also submit the EMD with Account Payee Demand Draft in favour of DCA MRAU payable at AT CHENNAI . Bidder has to upload scanned copy / proof of the DD along with bid and has to ensure delivery of hardcopy to the Buyer within 5 days of Bid End date / Bid Opening date. 10. Forms of EMD and PBG Successful Bidder can submit the Performance Security in the form of Account Payee Demand Draft also (besides PBG which is allowed as per GeM GTC). DD should be made in favour of DCA MRAU payable at AT CHENNAI . After award of contract, Successful Bidder can upload scanned copy of the DD in place of PBG and has to ensure delivery of hard copy to the original DD to the Buyer within 15 days of award of contract.
